durableFields.notes: Public discovery route events project creature-type target admission and creature-type protection active-effect admission from supported spell invocation facts and initial holes.

Public resolution route events project target selection, saving throw outcome, active-effect, concentration, hit point, condition lifecycle, attack roll, creature-state, and saving throw roll-mode ownership for protection/charm routes.
Existing active Spell Effect state owns Protection from Evil and Good scope, protected creature types, prevented conditions, attack roll disadvantage, and relevant-effect save advantage.
Existing active Spell Effect state owns Animal Friendship Charmed application and source-damage-break expiration facts.
Existing repeated-save active Spell Effect state owns relevant Charmed save roll-mode projection when creature-type protection applies.
Existing condition lifecycle state owns Charmed application, Charmed prevention, and charm source-damage-break condition removal.
Existing concentration state owns Protection from Evil and Good concentration after a successful cast.
Existing hit point state owns ally damage that breaks Animal Friendship.

notes: Task 10 introduced no new durable BattleState or BattleCreatureState fields.
New route subject families creatureTypeTargetAdmission, protectionCharmActiveEffect, and charmSourceDamageBreak are runtime projections in reducer-route.ts, not stored state.

Production behavior is admitted by support-profile shape, creature-type facts, active-effect scope, and typed possession disposition; it does not dispatch on spell id, spell name, authored slug, QNT action name, or connector filename.
